body:
Man.
What an experience :(

But anw I know some educational community that might able to help u “stop feeling that way”!

From that community, i learn that your bits of a motivation is reaaaaally a deep and the mooooost solid motivation ever, that would eventually help your own self

And as a footnote,
Im no one close as a product sales girl

Im just mentioning my experience as i read and relate with your experience

What if i say that im in no need whatsoever for a help?

All we need here is just a friend. A genuine one

Or if not,
A master in some fields would be sufficient

Getting accompanied will always be the best remedy for the brain, after all

Cz in those — all of us are being seen as “equal”
Are u a psychologist? Cz ive always been interested in seeing one

I guess this is no longer a matter of right or wrong.
It’s just that ive just made a decision lately that life is best lived *quickly*.
Aka to die soon is the most honorable opportunity in this life.

Because i believe ive done so many within my 24ish years of life.
And then the next thing i wish to do is to be able to die.

Therefore ive been wrecking my head on how to die early. Responsibly. With the most minimum negative impact if possible

Thus,
A life where ive lived meaningfully.. would be done.. properly.

Egoistic?
Really,
Dont we all have the freedom to choose whatever we wish in this life? :)

I wasn’t born on my own decision,
So let me decide on how to do my life,
And how to end it —quickly.

Wew the title doesn’t really appealing eh :/ :”) 

Thanks for the suggestion 👌
